oi_delta_clusters.note_en: Contract-by-contract open-interest change between the 2026-08-12 and 2026-08-13 chain snapshots. Counts of contracts added or closed at each strike — not a direction call. The newest stored snapshot is 9 trading sessions behind the latest close. Per-strike chain snapshots begin 2026-06-15, so this record is still short.
oi_delta_clusters.note_zh: 2026-08-12 与 2026-08-13 两次期权链快照之间逐张合约的未平仓量变化，显示各行权价新增或平掉的合约数量，不代表方向判断。最新的已存储快照比最近收盘落后 9 个交易日。逐行权价期权链快照自 2026-06-15 起累积，记录仍然很短。
oi_delta_clusters.spot_note_en: Strike distances here are measured against the snapshot source's price of 97.1, which differs from this board's price by 21.2%.
oi_delta_clusters.spot_note_zh: 此处的行权价距离以快照来源的价格 97.1 为基准，与本板块价格相差 21.2%。

regime_passport.note: dealer long-call/short-put sign is an unobservable assumption; single-name gamma regime is a near-constant product attribute, not a time-varying signal (validator MIN_PER_BUCKET structurally unreachable)

reliability.note: Direction soft — sign not NBBO-confirmed. All levels are descriptive maps, not forecasts.

wall_persistence.basis_en: This level is the heaviest open interest in the snapshot source's full contract list. The board's own call and put walls are dollar-gamma levels taken from a narrower window of a different chain source, so the two often land on different strikes.
wall_persistence.basis_zh: 此水平取自快照来源完整合约列表中未平仓量最重的行权价。本板块自身的看涨/看跌墙是另一个期权链来源、在更窄区间内计算的美元 Gamma 水平，因此两者经常落在不同的行权价上。

call_side.note_en: The heaviest call-side open interest has sat at 100 for the last 1 of 6 stored chain snapshots. Open-interest size is a count of contracts, not a dealer position. The newest stored snapshot is 9 trading sessions behind the latest close.
call_side.note_zh: 看涨未平仓量最重的行权价，在已存储的 6 次期权链快照中，最近 1 次落在 100。未平仓量是合约数量，不是做市商持仓。最新的已存储快照比最近收盘落后 9 个交易日。

put_side.note_en: The heaviest put-side open interest has sat at 80 in every one of the 6 stored chain snapshots, so it may have held longer than the window kept. Open-interest size is a count of contracts, not a dealer position. The newest stored snapshot is 9 trading sessions behind the latest close.
put_side.note_zh: 看跌未平仓量最重的行权价，在已存储的 6 次期权链快照中每一次都落在 80，实际持续时间可能长于已保存的窗口。未平仓量是合约数量，不是做市商持仓。最新的已存储快照比最近收盘落后 9 个交易日。

wall_persistence.spot_note_en: Strike distances here are measured against the snapshot source's price of 97.1, which differs from this board's price by 21.2%.
wall_persistence.spot_note_zh: 此处的行权价距离以快照来源的价格 97.1 为基准，与本板块价格相差 21.2%。
